# Onda for Mac 1.1.0 beta 124 — Reliable call recovery
- Return to your saved listening mode after calls, including when Onda restarts during a muted Google Meet call. - Spotify resumes automatically after the call when Onda paused it and the same track is still eligible to resume. Apple Music uses the same recovery safeguards. Music already paused before the call stays paused. - Improve reconnection to paired Bluetooth room speakers after sleep or disconnection, and preserve their saved volume and balance. - Keep your speaker choices, individual levels, timing and room tuning when updating.
This universal Mac beta is Developer ID signed, notarized and stapled. The audio driver remains 1.0.5 build 6; no driver update is needed. Automatic updates install when you quit Onda.
Verified with regression tests and a live muted Meet → Onda restart → leave call sequence, with Spotify resuming on two Studio Displays and a Bluetooth Sonos Move at the same balance. Bluetooth sleep/wake recovery was also tested. Apple Music shares the resume logic; its restart recovery was not separately tested live in this release. Detection and audio capture require the macOS permissions explained in Onda.
The iPhone app and its App Store submission are unchanged.
